visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) A middle-aged man with short dark hair and glasses, wearing a black button-down shirt, stands centrally against a blurred background showing a vibrant green and yellow bird. He begins his presentation with active hand gestures, his mouth moving in clear articulation. The lighting is bright and studio-like, focusing on his facial expressions. (2) A graphic overlay appears, illustrating a theoretical flying device with components labeled 'Airflow' and 'Thrust'. The background is a digital representation of Earth's atmosphere. The man's image is momentarily replaced or pushed to the side as the focus shifts to this scientific illustration. (3) The scene returns to the man in the black shirt. He uses a handheld pointer to emphasize his speech, pointing towards the camera or slightly off-screen. His expressions are engaged and informative, with frequent changes in hand positioning to reflect his narrative. (4) A technical schematic diagram is shown, detailing the 'nanocard' structure with heat transfer arrows labeled 'Sunlight', 'Airflow', and temperature indicators. The diagram is clean, utilizing blue and red color coding to signify thermal differences within the material's micro-layers. (5) Back to the presenter, who continues to explain the 'photophoresis' effect. He leans slightly forward, increasing the intensity of his gestures. The background bird image remains consistently blurred, providing a warm aesthetic contrast to the technical nature of his discussion. (6) A detailed 3D rendering and cross-section diagram of the 'breathing system'—a honeycomb-like nanostructure—occupies the screen. It highlights tiny pores within a sandwich-like structure, showing how air molecules are heated and expelled to create lift. (7) A video recording of a laboratory experiment is shown. A small, square-shaped technological sample is placed within a vacuum chamber. As light is applied, the sample visibly lifts off the surface, demonstrating successful gravity defiance. Text credits 'M. Azadi et al/Science Advances 2021' are visible. (8) The presenter concludes his talk, summarizing the potential applications such as improved weather forecasting and Mars exploration. He maintains a confident posture and professional gaze towards the camera, ending with a slight smile and final hand gesture.

(5) [Subtitle]: 最近哈佛大學的科學家. (6) [Subtitle]: 造出一張現實版的「光動力魔毯」. (7) [Subtitle]: 它沒有引擎、沒有燃料. (8) [Subtitle]: 只要有光. (9) [Subtitle]: 就能在地球大氣層最神秘的「禁飛區」. (10) [Subtitle]: 中氣層. [Variety]: 自由翱翔. (11) [Subtitle]: 這個中氣層. (12) [Subtitle]: 大約在我們頭頂50到85公里高. (13) [Subtitle]: 空氣稀薄到飛機的機翼吃不到風. (14) [Subtitle]: 飛不上去. (15) [Subtitle]: 氣球想再往上同樣浮力不足. (16) [Subtitle]: 但對衛星來說. (17) [Subtitle]: 空氣又太濃密了.
